_comment: Pick requests the captain has triaged OUT of a specific release. An entry means a human looked at the request and decided it is not going into that version. Keyed by issue number and by the release it is deferred FROM, so a pick request opened after the decision still blocks noOpenPicks and gets its own triage. The board's Target Release is the preferred place to record this; use this file when the board cannot express the target yet.

deferrals.reason: rc.5 is the golden RC, so the branch is held to validation-only changes. None of these is a reported 0.88 regression and all three carry cleanly to the first patch.

deferrals.reason: rc.6 is an exceptional RC cut for the AssetRegistry TypeScript fix (#1443) only, one cherry-pick. #1440, #1441 and #1446 all defer to 0.88.1. #1446 arrived after the rc.6 decision and is a real Android rendering bug in fontVariationSettings, assessed ACCEPT on its merits, so it should be first in line for the patch.
